stem:
Hassan has five odd-numbered cards. He wants to place all five cards so that their sum is exactly $30$.

What can he decide before trying any cases?

options.text: Call possible selection the answer, without using odd and even.
Treat the total $30$ as reachable with five odd cards, skipping the parity of five odds.
The sum is impossible, because five odd numbers have an odd sum and $30$ is even.
First pick any five odd cards, and say that choice is what creates the target total $30$.

teacher.key_rationale: Five odd addends always make an odd sum. An even target such as 30 can never match that forced parity, so the case is impossible without trying values.
